title: Book an economy seat on a one-way domestic flight
why: Confirms the basic booking path works end to end and returns the trip details with the price

steps.does: POST …/booking with PassengerId p1111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111, FlightId = the id of flight-1, Description 'Economy one-way'

expect: Booking is created for seat 12A at price 129.99 on flight AA1204 and a booking id is returned
